"use client";

import { AppSwitcher } from "@/components/ui/app-switcher";

/**
 * The app's mark — the ochre dot and the wordmark — and the button of the
 * suite's app switcher (@latro/ops-ui 1.1, library spec §10): it opens a
 * menu of the group's apps, each a plain link to its own sign-in.
 */
export function AppMark() {
  return (
    <AppSwitcher
      current="workforce"
      mark={
        <span className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <span aria-hidden className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-accent" />
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight text-sidebar-fg-active">Workforce Ops</span>
        </span>
      }
    />
  );
}
